02 / SLSA BUILD ASSURANCE

Defined requirements.
Evidence before a claim.

Specification
SLSA v1.2 · Build track
Target
Build L3
Current level claimed
None — not established
Provenance predicate type
https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1

The predicate URL identifies the official provenance format and remains the same in production. This page is the production documentation location; it is not itself a builder-signed provenance statement.

Hosted build evidence

A trusted hosted workflow must produce provenance identifying its source revision, builder, inputs and output artifact digests.

Protected build process

Build L3 requires evidence of isolated builds and protection against user-controlled provenance tampering, alongside the applicable builder controls.

Deployment binding

The published application must be linked to the exact artifact authenticated by the trusted builder’s provenance.

Current gap

The full rc22 provenance statement and its trusted hosted-builder controls have not been obtained and verified for this deployment. The runtime’s reported hashes alone do not fill that gap.

Assessment recorded September 12, 2026. Official SLSA levels · Build requirements.
